item.title: This shrubs need immediate pruning/ not done after last report, 9th August
item.description:
The shrubs( lower parts of actual trees on Peckham Hill Street ( bus stop) / Sister Mabel's Way, se 15 are so overgrown that the pavement all around is reduced massively. There was a report already last month but nothing has been done.This is next to a bus stop and it is now dangerous as it forces people closer to the road. It also feels unsafe especially in the night as visibility is totally reduced. Rubbish is being thrown in it as well. Please send tree surgeon to cut it right back to the base please as soon as possible as this is a second report. Thank you.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Sister Mabel's Way, Peckham, Greater London

item.title: Speeding cars and mopeds, 9th August
item.description:
I've personally witnessed countless speeding cars and mopeds, including some near misses with pedestrians crossing the road. This occurs alongside the whole street, and the junction across Lidl tends to be particularly dangerous as vehicles speed at night, Lidl closes late and shoppers have no safe crossing options. We need better traffic calming measures and/or speed cameras on this residential street.
